rows.query: Today for breakfast I had two scrambled eggs with butter and a slice of whole wheat toast with jam
For lunch I had a grilled chicken salad with 150g chicken breast, mixed greens, half an avocado, cherry tomatoes, and 2 tbsp olive oil dressing
My dinner was 200g salmon baked, 1 cup cooked brown rice, and a cup of steamed broccoli with butter
Breakfast: bowl of oatmeal made with milk, topped with banana and honey. Lunch: turkey sandwich with cheese and mayo. Snack: an apple.
I ate a McDonald's Big Mac meal with medium fries and a medium Coke, plus I added a McChicken on the side
Two slices of pepperoni pizza, a garlic knot, and a Caesar salad on the side with dressing
Protein shake with whey, a banana, a handful of almonds, and a scoop of peanut butter for a post-workout meal
For dinner I had a full Chipotle burrito bowl with chicken, white rice, pinto beans, mild salsa, cheese, and sour cream
Breakfast was a bagel with cream cheese and smoked salmon, plus orange juice
Dinner: pan-fried ribeye steak about 250g, baked potato with butter and sour cream, side of asparagus
